sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in commanding form overall with seven wins from their last ten outings, and they will be heavily favored against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just four points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday looking to close the one-point gap at the top after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in their last four, host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and on a three-game winning run, travel to Wednesfield Community, who have won two of their last three. Bilston Town, fifth and in strong form with three consecutive wins, host Foley Meir at home. Barnton, sixth, face Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table sides; Shawbury are in alarming form with six consecutive defeats. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a lower-mid-table encounter. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with Allscott having won two of their last three while Crewe continue to struggle. Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads in a basement battle between the division's two weakest sides. Widnes Town, pointless with just two draws from seven games, travel to Brereton Social, who themselves are struggling with three losses in their last six. On Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture.
